correctness.rationale: Direct focal hypergeometric payoff computation and a Pascal telescoping identity give the complete partial-sum coefficient, with exact sign and strict support. The Fermi birth-death fixation recurrence and reversed-state identity yield both fixation probabilities and monotonic reduced-chain spectral gap. A uniform fixed-group-size polynomial limit plus max-term log-sum bounds establishes the exponential gap formula; executable exact rational checks and reversed-chain comparisons passed independently. Claims are restricted to the rare-mutation reduced chain and positive finite selection intensity.

originality.rationale: The primary 2026 model establishes only the terminal cancellation and weak-selection condition. The new positivity identity for every partial cumulative payoff, strict dual fixation monotonicity at all finite positive selection strengths, sharp switching-rate interval, and exponentially sharp population-size separation are not implication-equivalent to its published conclusions. A 2024 linear-return special-family weak-selection result is acknowledged as partial coverage. Classical Fermi fixation and rare-mutation techniques, including the exact logistic stationary proportion, are explicitly not claimed as new.
residual_risks: A prior equivalent all-intensity monotonicity result may exist under alternative game/payoff terminology; search is not a priority certificate.
The rare-mutation homogeneous-state reduction should not be confused with the full finite-mutation chain; analogous claims in different update processes are not established.
The Fudenberg–Imhof article was not inspected beyond its accessible abstract; it concerns the generic reduction, not the source-specific kernel.

value.rationale: The terminal-return-only abundance finding leaves switching dynamics uncharacterized; the new kernel resolves how every individual mixed return affects both invasion directions at all intensities, while stationary abundance stays constant. Sharp rate bounds and an explicit exponentially large substitution-mixing separation for each fixed n>=3 with all returns positive give a natural dynamical invariant and substantive interpretation, not a renamed endpoint identity.
